TV for Dogs – Real Pack Life from Doggy Woods Retreat

Welcome to Doggy Woods Retreat — your pup’s new favorite network for DogTV-style videos filmed around the world.

We create TV for dogs: long, calming videos that entertain and comfort pups who are home alone, anxious, or just love watching other dogs.

These are real-life pack walks, forest adventures, and social time from our dog boarding and daycare business and friends around the world — not artificial loops or stock clips.

If your dog gets anxious, bored, or just loves watching other dogs… this is the real DogTV alternative they’ll love.

Josh, Colette, Eve, and our friends are proud to share real dogs playing, exploring, and relaxing together.
